verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs show extensive API coverage for core features (payments, refunds, disputes, billing, webhooks, connect, idempotency, sandboxes) plus dedicated CLI and MCP server for agent/API-driven workflows, strongly supporting API-first operation. However, some capabilities are explicitly framed as dashboard/no-code only (e.g., 'no-code refunds', 'create... invoice from the Dashboard, with no code required', revenue-recovery features requiring 'no code'), and a community report describes a dashboard-only feature (Issuing) being blocked without a clear API path, indicating imperfect UI/API parity.
